bio: I'm an aspiring SOC analyst based in California, focused on threat detection, SIEM monitoring, and incident triage. I'm currently pursuing my Master's in Cybersecurity at WGU and building hands-on experience through Wazuh-based home labs and phishing analysis projects. I love camping, mountain biking, and spending time with my dogs.
